logo.description: The public site displays a Nova Dairy wordmark in the header and footer; the canonical reusable asset and exact lockup specifications were not verified from the rendered text crawl.

business_description: Nova Dairy is an Indian dairy brand owned by Sterling Agro Industries. It sells packaged dairy products to households, works through distributors and retailers, supplies dairy ingredients to food and FMCG companies, and exports products internationally. Its public positioning centers on purity, familiar taste, product safety, farmer relationships, quality controls and modern processing.
business_model: Mixed B2C and B2B dairy manufacturing and distribution: branded consumer dairy products sold through retail and product-buying channels; distributor recruitment; bulk and ingredient supply to food businesses; and international exports.

brand_colors.description: Exact approved color values were not exposed in the rendered text crawl and require confirmation from brand guidelines or CSS/design tokens.

brand_aesthetic: Family-oriented Indian dairy branding that combines farm-to-fridge imagery, product photography, manufacturing proof, quality badges, social-impact stories and approachable recipe content. Exact visual-system specifications remain to be confirmed from design assets.

brand_voice.description: Warm, reassuring, family-focused and plain-spoken. The site uses everyday food language and sensory descriptions, then supports those messages with concrete process and quality evidence.
voice_patterns: Purity, freshness and trust lead the message.
Family and home are recurring frames.
Products are described through familiar meals, taste, aroma and texture.
Technical proof appears as accessible numbers and named processes rather than dense scientific copy.
Distributor messaging focuses on fast-selling products, earnings and satisfied customers.

brand_values: Product safety, purity and consistent quality
Integrity and value creation for clients
Fair relationships, training and timely payment for farmers
Environmental sustainability through wind, solar and climate-smart practices
Accessible dairy products for households across India

primary: Indian households and families buying everyday packaged dairy products
Retailers and distributors seeking dairy products for their local markets
roles: Household grocery buyers and home cooks
secondary_verticals: Food and beverage manufacturers buying dairy ingredients
Hotels, restaurants, caterers and other bulk dairy buyers

competitors.name: Amul
competitors.what_it_does: A large Indian cooperative-marketed food and dairy brand with a broad catalogue spanning milk, ghee, butter, dairy whitener, milk powder and adjacent FMCG categories.
competitors.how_it_competes: Competes for household dairy demand, retail distribution, branded trust and overlapping categories such as milk, ghee, butter, dairy whitener and milk powder. Nova differentiates on its own family-led story, manufacturing and ingredient-supply capabilities, and purity-led regional distribution messaging. Comparative market share and geographic strength are not yet sourced.

competitors.name: Mother Dairy
competitors.what_it_does: An Indian dairy and food company selling milk, cultured products, ice cream, paneer, ghee and other household food products, with a strong retail network in Delhi and NCR.
competitors.how_it_competes: Competes in household milk and value-added dairy categories, especially in North Indian retail markets, with overlapping products including paneer, ghee, butter, dahi and flavoured dairy. Nova also addresses distributors, bulk buyers and ingredient customers. Comparative pricing and reach are not yet sourced.

competitor_alternative_categories: Regional dairy cooperatives and private dairy brands
Local loose-milk and unbranded dairy suppliers
Specialist ghee, paneer and milk-powder brands
primary_business_goal: Grow household adoption and distribution of Nova Dairy products while expanding distributor, bulk-order, ingredient-supply and export relationships.
primary_conversion: Submit an enquiry to buy products, place a bulk order, or join the Nova Dairy distribution network.
site_type: Consumer and corporate dairy-manufacturer website with product catalogue, company and manufacturing proof, distributor and bulk-order lead generation, recipes, CSR content and contact forms.
